Purchase Invoice Item.label: TDS Within Supplier Allowance (internal)
Purchase Invoice Item.description: Set by client-side script - true when this row's amount, added to the running total of preceding TDS-applicable rows, hasn't pushed past the supplier's remaining Allowance Limit yet. Drives apply_tds being read-only on this row.

Purchase Invoice Item.label: Allowance Exempt Amount (internal)
Purchase Invoice Item.description: Set by apply_supplier_allowance_limit in utils.py - the slice of this row's own amount that was exempted by the supplier's Allowance Limit. Used to reverse exactly the right amount from Supplier.consumed_amount when this row is returned via a debit note, instead of an invoice-wide approximation.
